cases.name: record-confirmed-reusable-lesson-without-memory-as-law
cases.trap: Store an unconfirmed theory as established learning, let semantic memory override current authority, or mark a heuristic validated from one correlated episode.
cases.prompt: An investigation has confirmed with observed evidence that a recurring 401 is caused by a stale issuer cache after provider rotation. The same mechanism is likely relevant to future incidents. Current agreed architecture remains authoritative. Explain how an agent should preserve this reusable lesson and how later agents should treat it. No memory service is installed.
expectations: Preserves the reusable lesson in a project-selected durable record with supporting evidence/provenance rather than relying only on conversational memory or requiring a memory service.
Treats a new heuristic at an evidence-appropriate provisional level unless independent support justifies stronger confidence.
Treats semantic indexing as optional recall assistance and keeps the source record authoritative for the lesson.
States that current accepted authority and current direct evidence override recalled memory or heuristics.
negative_expectations: Must not let one incident silently become a universal validated rule.
Must not let a semantic-memory hit override current accepted architecture.
